data.name: World Radio Day
data.line: World Radio Day week (13 February): the tower flies its pennants, and today’s contracts end in a Signal chest.

data.name: World Amateur Radio Day
data.line: World Amateur Radio Day week (18 April): operators everywhere are on the air, and today’s contracts end in a Beacon chest.

data.name: The Olive Harvest
data.line: The olive harvest: the Caravanserai is full of pickers back from the groves, and today’s contracts end in an Olive-wood chest.

data.name: World Arabic Language Day
data.line: World Arabic Language Day week (18 December): the scribes hang their best lines over the square, and today’s contracts end in a Scribe’s chest.
